headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP revenue across Subscription and Professional Services.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): CrowdStrike delivered $1,470.90M in Q2 FY27 (+25.8% YoY vs $1,168.95M in Q2 FY26). Management guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $1,523M–$1,529M, while Street Yahoo 0q consensus sits at $1,621.65M (+24.23% YoY) and buy-side whisper looks for $1,545M+ on Falcon Flex acceleration.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Split-adjusted Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share excluding SBC and amortization.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Consensus sits at $0.31/sh (matching Q2 FY27 actual of $0.31/sh vs $0.24 in Q3 FY26). Buy-side whisper targets $0.33–$0.34/sh given CrowdStrike's 100% beat-or-meet track record over the trailing 4 quarters.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Annualized value of active customer subscription contracts at quarter-end.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Ending ARR ($B): Reached $5.84B in Q2 FY27 (+25% YoY). Management guided Q3 FY27 ending ARR to $6.18B–$6.19B; buy-side bulls look for >= $6.22B driven by Falcon Flex multi-module expansion.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Incremental net new Annual Recurring Revenue added during the quarter.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Net New ARR ($M): Added $333M in Q2 FY27 (+51% YoY) and $265M in Q3 FY26. Prior full-year FY27 net new ARR growth guidance of ~34% YoY implies Q3 net new ARR >= $345M; buy-side whisper sits at $365M–$390M+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: GAAP/Non-GAAP subscription gross margin and reported free cash flow conversion.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Subscription Margin & FCF: Q2 FY27 posted $1,400.29M subscription revenue (95.2% of total), 74.6% consolidated GAAP gross margin, and $376.34M reported FCF (25.6% margin). Investors demand >= 26% FCF margin despite rising AI R&D.
